method: match ZED-visible far wall to far LiDAR wall; infer camera-side wall and lateral sensor offset from common wall gap and floor height

corridor_frame.X: hallway direction, camera at X=0; lidar X offset unresolved
corridor_frame.Y: from the camera-side wall toward the ZED-visible far wall

assumptions: ZED wall and LiDAR far wall are the same physical wall.
LiDAR near wall and inferred camera-side wall are the same boundary.
Both plane fits refer to the same straight corridor cross section.
limitation: Parallel side walls and the floor do not constrain the LiDAR-camera translation along X.
